data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2019 were GBP 767.4m. During 2019 the syndicate recorded an overall deterioration in prior-year reserves of GBP 36.3m (adverse development), driven predominantly by large catastrophe losses and adverse attritional development on 2017 and earlier years - notably US hurricane activity (Harvey, Irma, Maria), California wildfires and Mexico earthquakes - and by deterioration on several short-tail classes. The reserve strengthening primarily affected property, marine and energy-related portfolios and contributed to the loss on the 2017 closed year of account.
raw_causal_phrases: series of large losses on 2017 and prior underwriting years
increased attritional losses on those same years
overall deterioration of GBP 36.3m (2018: improvement of GBP 11.1m)
worst year for catastrophes in the United States for over a decade with Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, the wildfires in California and earthquakes in Mexico
deterioration from expected loss ratios from short tail lines of business namely US Direct and Facultative, Cargo, Yachts & Hull, UK SME and Onshore energy
large loss activity on 2018 which has influenced the actions outlined above
